nodes.label: Stale SHM cache invalidation
nodes.rationale: A same-name SHM segment can be unlinked and recreated at a different size across a camera add/remove or resolution change while a long-lived in-process cache (e.g. TrackedObjectProcessor) still holds the old ref. A too-small cached ref makes np.ndarray raise 'buffer is too small'; a too-large one passes any size check but points at an orphaned inode whose stale bytes get reinterpreted at the new shape, producing miscolored distorted YUV. Both must drop the cache and reopen by name; if the reopened segment is still too small (maintainer mid-recreate) skip the frame and do not cache it. Size must be computed with np.prod so n-dimensional shapes work.
